vulnerabilities.name: Docker-in-Docker service detected
vulnerabilities.message: job ".docker_dind_cache_pattern" uses Docker-in-Docker service "docker:29.5.2-dind"
vulnerabilities.description:
A CI/CD job uses a Docker-in-Docker (dind) service. On shared runners running in privileged mode, this enables container escape, lateral movement, and access to secrets from other jobs on the same runner.

Finding: job ".docker_dind_cache_pattern" uses Docker-in-Docker service "docker:29.5.2-dind"
vulnerabilities.solution: Replace Docker-in-Docker with a safer alternative such as Kaniko or Buildah for building container images. These tools do not require privileged mode and avoid the security risks of running a Docker daemon inside a CI container.

A CI/CD job uses a Docker-in-Docker (dind) service. On shared runners running in privileged mode, this enables container escape, lateral movement, and access to secrets from other jobs on the same runner.

Finding: job "build" uses Docker-in-Docker service "docker:29.5.2-dind"
vulnerabilities.solution: Replace Docker-in-Docker with a safer alternative such as Kaniko or Buildah for building container images. These tools do not require privileged mode and avoid the security risks of running a Docker daemon inside a CI container.

vulnerabilities.name: Docker-in-Docker with insecure daemon configuration
vulnerabilities.message: Job '.docker_dind_cache_pattern': DOCKER_TLS_CERTDIR is empty (TLS disabled)
vulnerabilities.description:
A CI/CD job uses Docker-in-Docker with an insecure daemon configuration. Setting DOCKER_TLS_CERTDIR to an empty string or using DOCKER_HOST with tcp://...:2375 disables TLS encryption between the CI job and the Docker daemon, allowing network-level eavesdropping and command injection.

Finding: Job '.docker_dind_cache_pattern': DOCKER_TLS_CERTDIR is empty (TLS disabled)
vulnerabilities.solution: If Docker-in-Docker is required, ensure TLS is enabled: do not set DOCKER_TLS_CERTDIR to an empty string, and use tcp://docker:2376 (TLS) instead of tcp://docker:2375 (plaintext). Prefer Kaniko or Buildah to avoid this pattern entirely.
